variants.prompt: REFORM LIGHTING/TIME: On the rooftop of a sleek, modern high-rise at the peak of golden hour, she leans against the railing, the city skyline stretching out before her. The black leather jacket and tight red dress are now a skintight, metallic silver bodysuit that clings to her every contour. Her striking amber eyes sparkle under the warm sunset glow, her raven-black hair blown back by the gentle breeze. A DSLR camera, set to capture the vibrant colors and long shadows, shoots her in a dramatic, shallow focus wide shot, the bustling cityscape blurred in the background.
